about_the_game:
Choyo Girl Lilina 2 is a game about the training journey of a 16-year-old magical girl.

At the age of 13, she was rescued by a special forces unit and began working as a magician.
To become a stronger magician, she travels from village to village, training and gaining experience.

Guided by a secret agent from the first village, she moves on to the next village.
Helping villagers with their troubles will earn her rewards, allowing her to purchase better items.

Experience Lilina as she overcomes hardships, defeating wrongdoers and dangerous creatures!

Supports subtitles in Korean, English, Japanese, Turkish, German, and Indonesian.
Basic voice acting is available in Korean, English, and Japanese.

Choyo Girl Lilina 2 is an RPG where you embark on an adventure and enhance Lilina's abilities.

If you encounter an enemy too strong to defeat, level up and purchase better equipment to overcome the challenge!

Controls:
Move: Arrow Keys
Select: Spacebar
Menu: ESC Key
